steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Stress is the force applied to rock; strain is the resulting deformation | Key Fact: Brittle deformation: rocks fracture under stress, producing joints, faults and fractures (dominant at shallow depths, low temperature, fast strain rate) | Key Fact: Ductile deformation: rocks bend or flow under stress, producing folds and cleavage (dominant at depth, high temperature, slow strain rate) | Key Fact: Normal faults form under tension: the hanging wall moves down relative to the footwall

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from rock deformation &amp; stress, and one past-paper question.
